summary: Iteration 16 — regression of latest Site Visit module enhancements. 27/27 backend pytest cases pass; all targeted frontend flows render correctly (PhotoMap with markers, customer-contact strip, smart 4-digit Job No auto-fill, engineer RBAC, pin-to-project). Created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration16_sv_enhancements.py covering pin/unpin, per-photo GPS persistence, photo upload, smart job-no search, dashboard/my-sv-weekly, web push (VAPID + subscribe), PDF/Excel exports, notifications + activity log, engineer RBAC, and CRUD regression. No critical or blocking issues. Two pre-existing cosmetic console warnings remain (React hydration: <span> inside <option>; Recharts width/height(-1) on hidden charts) — both already noted in iter15 and unchanged.

issues: PhotoMap container has no data-testid (e.g. 'photo-map') on the outer wrapper — only Leaflet's .leaflet-container is queryable. Adding data-testid='photo-map' would aid automation.
React hydration warning: <span> rendered as a child of <option>. Move helper text out of <option> or strip span tags inside option content (cosmetic — does not break UI).
Recharts logs 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' when ResponsiveContainer mounts in a hidden/zero-size parent. Set explicit min-h or guard render until in-view.

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid='photo-map' on the PhotoMap component wrapper in /app/frontend/src/components/PhotoMap.jsx so e2e tests can target it directly.
(Cosmetic) Remove <span> children inside <option> in SiteVisitFormPage template <select> to silence hydration warning.
(Cosmetic) Give Recharts ResponsiveContainer a minHeight or render-when-visible guard.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is 4624 lines — should be split into routers/modules (clients, projects, site_visits, audits, push, dashboard).
POST /api/site-visits/{vid}/pin currently always sets is_pinned to provided bool — multiple visits can be pinned per project, which matches docstring intent; UI should make this clear to admins.
Photo upload endpoint /api/site-visits/uploads accepts file only; lat/lng/captured_at are persisted via the SiteVisit POST body — confirmed working but undocumented. Add docstring note.
/api/notifications returns {items, unread} (object) on admin path but historically older tests treated it as a list — keep the shape stable and document it.

Use the new pytest file as regression baseline. The PhotoMap testid is missing on the component wrapper — Playwright must use '.leaflet-container' until the testid is added.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional issues found this run. Three failing tests during initial pytest run were assertion-shape mismatches in the test script itself (my-sv-weekly returns by_day/by_project not 'weekly'; /api/notifications returns {items, unread} not a list). Fixed test assertions to match real API shape; final run is 27/27 green.
